title: Solar eclipse omen in the 7th year of Mursilis
summary: A solar eclipse omen recorded in the 7th year of the Hittite king Mursilis.
description: A solar eclipse omen recorded in the 7th year of the Hittite king Mursilis. Recorded from a CFAH OSF preprint anchor point (not yet published in ARJ). Added by the CFAH pass.
